description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'FileWidget' for a file upload widget, including configuration, form handling, validation, and submission logic for managing file uploads within Drupal's field system.

classes.name: FileWidget
classes.description: A Drupal widget class for managing file uploads, including configuration, form rendering, validation, and submission handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget with dependencies, including the element info manager.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the widget, including progress indicator type.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the widget, allowing selection of progress indicator type.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings.

methods.name: formMultipleElements
methods.description: Handles rendering of multiple file upload elements, supporting drag-and-drop and 'add more' functionality.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds a single file upload form element, extending managed_file with additional features.

methods.name: massageFormValues
methods.description: Transforms form input values into the format expected by the entity field, especially for multiple files.

methods.name: extractFormValues
methods.description: Updates widget state with current form values after submission.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value for the file field, including display and description info.

methods.name: validateMultipleCount
methods.description: Validates the number of uploaded files against field cardinality, warning and trimming excess files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a file field element, adding display and description fields, and AJAX behavior.

methods.name: processMultiple
methods.description: Processes multiple file elements, adding weight and AJAX wrapper for dynamic updates.

methods.name: getDescriptionFromElement
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptive label for a file element, falling back to filename if needed.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for upload/remove buttons, updating widget state accordingly.

methods.name: flagErrors
methods.description: Overrides error flagging to suppress validation errors for remove buttons.
